queries: hydrogen refueling station vehicle filling synchronized pressure temperature time series dataset download
NREL HDVS fueling data time series station vehicle pressure temperature mass flow
70 MPa hydrogenation port test dataset raw xlsx
search_scope.eligibility_rule: A reusable physical event must expose station/controller and dispenser/nozzle plus vehicle/receptacle channels on a common clock, with units, initial conditions, tank capacity, protocol metadata and rights sufficient for independent scoring.

sources.name: NREL Heavy-Duty Hydrogen Fueling Performance Demonstration
sources.observed_role: reported 73 kg HD vehicle-simulator fill using SAE protocol at 70 MPa and 300 g/s
sources.reason: The report provides event-level performance results and plotted/summary values, but no reusable row-level synchronized logger archive, channel dictionary or raw-data reuse terms.

sources.name: NREL Fuel Cell Vehicle Infrastructure CRADA report
sources.observed_role: more than 90 vehicle or simulator fuelings and station/vehicle interaction examples
sources.reason: The report explicitly presents figures and aggregate observations; the underlying detailed partner data are protected and no rights-cleared synchronized raw archive is released.

sources.name: NREL Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Composite Data Products
sources.observed_role: public aggregate fill duration, fill amount, pressure and temperature products
sources.reason: Composite statistics are not event-level station/controller/dispenser/vehicle traces and cannot be scored as a prospective raw holdout.

sources.name: 70 MPa hydrogenation-port test dataset (NBS DC)
sources.observed_role: 73.94 MB, 15-file component test collection with xlsx/mp4/pdf/docx entries
sources.reason: The catalog requires account registration/login and does not expose an openly reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle archive or licence in the public record. It is a request lead, not an eligible holdout.

sources.name: Estimation of temperature change in practical hydrogen pressure tanks being filled at high pressures
sources.observed_role: published measured 35/70 MPa practical tank-fill temperature study
sources.reason: The article establishes useful operating context and describes measured station/tank quantities, but the public record does not provide a rights-cleared machine-readable synchronized raw logger bundle.

primary_goal_impact.paper_limitation: Do not claim independent station-to-vehicle full-loop accuracy, vehicle-controller validation or field-safety validation from these reports or aggregate products.
primary_goal_impact.reentry_condition: Obtain at least three rights-cleared events with station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels on a common clock; freeze the scoring protocol before accessing outcomes.

claim_boundary: This is a public-access availability audit. It does not prove that restricted, proprietary or unpublished traces do not exist.
